title.rendered: Arqaam acted as Joint Bookrunner on Action Energy Company’s successful IPO

content.rendered:
Arqaam capital is proud to have acted as a joint Bookrunner on the successful IPO of Action Energy Company and its strong first-day performance on Boursa Kuwait.

This milestone reflects the confidence the Issuer and investors have placed in Arqaam capital capabilities. The positive market reception is a testament to our research, distribution and executions capabilities

We are truly grateful to have worked with such an amazing team.
 

View More
